blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for codebook-based content analysis in computational social science, where codebooks translate theoretical concepts into labeling schemes. While prior work reports strong predictive performance, it remains unclear whether these systems produce reliable and robust text annotations. We conduct a large-scale empirical failure-mode analysis of LLM-based coding pipelines across four datasets and five models by systematically evaluating their stability, robustness, and conceptual validity under controlled perturbations, domain shifts, and optimization procedures. We uncover multiple failure modes that are largely invisible under standard metrics, showing that high aggregate scores frequently coexist with severe label-level disparities, instability across runs, domain sensitivity, and shifts in label interpretation. Importantly, these failure modes persist under widely used optimization strategies and remain largely invisible under standard metrics such as accuracy and micro-F1. Our results demonstrate that current LLM-based coding pipelines cannot be treated as stable measurement tools without targeted validation beyond aggregate performance.
blocks.zh: 大语言模型(LLMs)在计算社会科学中被越来越多地用于基于代码库的内容分析,其中代码库将理论概念转化为标签计划. 虽然以前的工作报告有很强的预测性能,但尚不清楚这些系统是否产生可靠和有力的文字说明。 我们对四个数据集和五个模型的基于LLM的编码管道进行大规模的经验性故障模型分析,方法是在受控扰动、域移和优化程序下系统地评估其稳定性、稳健性和概念有效性。 我们发现了在标准衡量标准下基本上看不见的多种失败模式,表明高总分往往与严重的标签水平差异、跨运行的不稳定性、域敏感度和标签解释的转变并存。 重要的是,在广泛使用的优化战略下,这些故障模式持续存在,在精确度和微F1等标准衡量标准下,这些模式基本上仍然看不见。 我们的结果表明,目前基于LLM的编码管道不能作为稳定的计量工具,除非进行超出总体性能的针对性验证。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to annotate text data using natural language instructions, enabling scalable labeling for tasks such as dataset construction, qualitative coding, and content analysis ( Törnberg, 2024 ; Abraham et al., 2025 ; Rytting et al., 2023 ; Xiao et al., 2023 ) . In computational social science (CSS), these instructions are typically formalized as codebooks, structured annotation guidelines that map theoretical concepts onto predefined labels. For example, a codebook for analysing news coverage of minimum wage policies might define labels such as Prices , Government , Welfare , and Justice to classify the different concepts through which minimum wage policies are discussed in each text. By incorporating
the codebook’s labels and their definitions
directly into prompts, recent studies report strong predictive performance and substantial agreement between human and LLM annotations, suggesting that LLMs could serve as scalable substitutes for human coders ( Rytting et al., 2023 ; Ramanathan et al., 2025 ; Ruckdeschel, 2025 ; Farjam et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh:
大语言模型(LLM)越来越多地用于使用自然语言指令对文本数据进行注释,从而能够对数据集构建、质量编码和内容分析等任务进行可扩展标签(Törnberg,2024;Abraham等人,2025;Rytting等人,2023;Xiao等人,2023)。 在计算社会科学(CSS)中,这些指示通常被正式化为代码本,结构化的注释准则,将理论概念映射到预定义的标签上. 例如,用于分析最低工资政策新闻报道的编码手册可以界定价格、政府、福利和司法等标签,以分类在每一文本中讨论最低工资政策的不同概念。 通过纳入
代码簿的标签及其定义
近期的研究表明,人与LLM说明的预测性能很强,而且相当一致,这表明LLMs可以作为人类编码器的可扩展替代品(Rytting等人,2023年;Ramanathan等人,2025年;Ruckdeschel,2025年;Farjam等人,2025年)。

blocks.en:
However, the use of LLMs for codebook-based annotation introduces two sources of potential failure. First, LLMs may fail to apply codebook instructions consistently during inference. A growing body of NLP research highlights prompt sensitivity ( Shu et al., 2024 ; Mizrahi et al., 2024 ; Gu et al., 2023 ) , where model predictions change under seemingly minor prompt variations, such as formatting choices, label ordering, or wording differences. Beyond prompt sensitivity,
LLM-based coding pipelines may also exhibit broader robustness issues, including instability across repeated runs, inconsistent adherence to codebook definitions, and large disparities in performance across individual labels.
Second, LLMs are increasingly used not only to apply annotation instructions but also to refine or optimize the prompts themselves. Recent approaches employ automatic prompt optimization or multi-agent prompting frameworks to iteratively modify prompts in order to improve predictive performance ( Abraham et al., 2025 ; Zhao et al., 2025 ) . While these methods can yield improvements on standard evaluation metrics, they also introduce additional risks. For instance, modifying prompts that encode coding schemes can implicitly alter label definitions, amplify disparities in label-level performance, or shift the conceptual meaning of the constructs being measured (see Section 5 ).
These issues are consequential in content analysis, where annotations function as measurements ( Krippendorff, 2018 ) . They feed downstream statistical analyses (frequency comparisons, regressions, hypothesis testing), as well as qualitative interpretation, including conceptual and relational analysis. This requires that performance is balanced across labels for frequency-based claims to hold ( Egami et al., 2023 ) , results are comparable across runs, models, and corpora for findings to replicate, and the labels must retain the theoretical constructs the codebook was designed to measure ( Halterman and Keith, 2025 ) .
blocks.zh:
然而,使用LLMS进行基于编码本的注释,提出了两种可能失败的来源. 首先,LLMS在推论期间可能无法一致地应用代码表指令. 越来越多的NLP研究突出了即时灵敏度(Shu等人,2024年;Mizrahi等人,2024年;Gu等人,2023年),其中模型预测在格式化选择,标签顺序,或措辞差异等看似微小的即时变化下发生变化. 除了迅速的敏感,
基于LLM的编码管道还可能显示更广泛的强性问题,包括反复运行的不稳定性、对代码簿定义的遵守不一致,以及各个标签之间表现的巨大差异。
第二,LLMs不仅越来越多地用于应用注释指示,而且还用于完善或优化提示本身。 最近的办法采用自动即时优化或多剂激励框架,反复修改提示,以改善预测性能(Abraham等人,2025年;Zhao等人,2025年)。 虽然这些方法可以改进标准评价衡量标准,但也带来了更多的风险。 例如,修改编码编码办法的提示可以隐含地改变标签定义,扩大标签级别性能的差异,或转移所计量的构造的概念含义(见第5节)。
这些问题在内容分析中是必然的,其中说明作为测量功能(Krippendorff,2018.). 它们为下游的统计分析(频率比较、回归、假设测试)以及定性解释,包括概念和关系分析提供了信息。 这要求基于频率的诉求的标签之间要平衡性能(Egami等人,2023年),结果可以相互比较,模型和公司可以复制研究结果,标签必须保留代码本设计用来测量的理论构造(Halterman和Keith,2025年).

blocks.en:
In this paper, we operationalize the risks around faithful LLM coding by defining controlled experiments and complementary metrics. Then, we empirically demonstrate that current LLM-based codebook methods systematically fail in predictable ways.
We organize our study around a set of failure modes , spanning two stages of practical CSS pipelines: (1) inference failure modes , which arise when an LLM applies a fixed codebook (see Section 4 ), and (2) optimization-induced failure modes , which arise when an LLM is used to refine a codebook prior to inference (see Section 5 ).
Our main contributions are: • A framework for systematic failure-mode analysis for LLM content analysis, identifying predictable breakdowns at both the inference and optimization stages. • Evidence across four datasets and five models that commonly reported performance metrics can misrepresent coding reliability by masking these failures, along with a minimal validation protocol (see Section 6 ) to uncover such failure modes. • Two new expert-annotated datasets sharing a single codebook, enabling controlled domain-transfer evaluation, as well as code and evaluation pipeline to support reproducibility. 1 1 1 Value creation Science dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/ElenaSenger/value-creation-science ; Value creation News dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/ElenaSenger/value-creation-news ; Code: https://github.com/elenasenger/high-scores-hidden-failures
blocks.zh:
在本文中,我们通过界定受控制的实验和补充的衡量标准,将围绕忠实的LLM编码的风险付诸实施。 然后,我们从经验中证明,目前基于LLM的编码簿方法以可预测的方式系统失败。
我们围绕一套故障模式组织研究,涉及两个阶段的实际CSS管道:(1) 推论故障模式,当LLM应用固定的代码簿(见第4节),(2) 优化引起的故障模式,当LLM在推论前用于完善代码簿(见第5节)。
我们的主要贡献是: • 为LLM内容分析提供系统故障模式分析的框架,在推论和优化阶段确定可预测的故障。 • 4个数据集和5个模型的证据,通常报告的性能衡量标准可以掩盖这些故障,从而错误地对可靠性进行编码,同时制定最低限度的验证协议(见第6节),以发现这种故障模式。 • 支助 两个新的专家附加说明的数据集共享一个单一的代码簿,能够进行受控域-传输评价,以及支持可复制的代码和评价管道. 1 1 价值创造 科学数据集:https://huggingface.co/datasets/ElenaSenger/价值创造-科学; 创造价值 新闻数据集:https://huggingface.co/datasets/ElenaSenger/value-create-news;代码:https://github.com/elenasenger/high-score-hidden-faulures.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Reliability of LLM-Based Text Annotation
blocks.zh: 2.1 基于LLM的文本注释的可靠性

blocks.en: In CSS, LLMs are increasingly used to generate annotations for downstream analyses, such as estimating prevalence or testing hypotheses ( Gligoric et al., 2025 ; Baumann et al., 2025 ) . It has been shown that LLM annotations vary depending on the design of the prompt, the domain, the task, or the choice of model ( Aldeen et al., 2023 ; Kocoń et al., 2023 ) . Therefore, naive use can produce unreliable statistical estimates ( Gligoric et al., 2025 ) and propagate to downstream statistical inference ( Baumann et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 在CSS中,LLMs越来越多地用于生成下游分析的说明,如估计流行率或测试假设(Gligoric等人,2025年;Baumann等人,2025年)。 已经显示,LLM说明因即时,域,任务的设计或模型的选择而异(Aldeen等人,2023年;Kocoń等人,2023年). 因此,天真使用可产生不可靠的统计估计(Gligoric等人,2025年),并传播到下游的统计推论(Baumann等人,2025年)。

blocks.en: Within content analysis, research has increasingly explored how LLMs can leverage codebooks in zero-shot or few-shot coding scenarios ( Rytting et al., 2023 ; Dunivin, 2025 ; Farjam et al., 2025 ) . Prior work shows that incorporating codebook definitions or examples can improve classification performance ( Ruckdeschel, 2025 ; Xiao et al., 2023 ) . Other studies highlight that prompt design choices and codebook components (e.g., “Negative Clarification” or “Positive Example”) can influence model predictions ( Halterman and Keith, 2025 ) . Some work also reports variability in LLM coding results across repeated runs despite strong overall agreement with human annotations ( Ramanathan et al., 2025 ) , suggesting that stability remains an underexplored dimension of evaluation. However, existing studies primarily focus on aggregate performance metrics ( Ruckdeschel, 2025 ; Xiao et al., 2023 ; Rytting et al., 2023 ; Dunivin, 2025 ; Farjam et al., 2025 ) , leaving open questions about robustness, label-level disparities, and other potential failure modes when LLMs apply codebooks.
blocks.zh: 在内容分析方面,研究越来越多地探索LLMs如何在零镜头或几镜头编码方案下利用代码簿(Rytting等人,2023年;Dunivin,2025年;Farjam等人,2025年)。 先前的工作表明,纳入编码本的定义或实例可以提高分类性能(Ruckdeschel,2025;Xiao等人,2023)。 其他研究强调,即时设计选择和编码本组件(例如“负面澄清”或“潜在示例”)可影响模型预测(Harterman和Keith,2025年)。 一些工作还报告说,尽管总体上同意人类说明(Ramanathan等人,2025年),但LLM编码结果在反复出现时存在差异,这表明稳定性仍然是评价中未得到充分探讨的一个方面。 然而,现有的研究主要侧重于总体性能衡量标准(Ruckdeschel, 2025年;Shao等人, 2023年;Rytting等人, 2023年;Dunivin, 2025年;Farjam等人, 2025年),在LLMs应用代码簿时,对稳健性、标签级别差异和其他潜在故障模式仍有疑问。

blocks.en: Where prior work documents that predictions shift under prompt variation, we systematically evaluate published codebook-design recommendations ( Ruckdeschel, 2025 ; Halterman and Keith, 2025 ; Dunivin, 2025 ) , run-to-run stability, label-name reliance, and domain transfer under controlled conditions. Our analysis extends prior findings by decomposing these effects at the label level and distinguishing robustness to stylistic variation from adherence to the underlying coding concepts.
blocks.zh: 在预测迅速变化的先前工作文件中,我们系统地评价已公布的编码设计建议(Ruckdeschel, 2025年;Harterman和Keith, 2025年;Dunivin, 2025年),运行稳定性,标签名称依赖,以及控制条件下的域名转让。 我们的分析扩展了先前的调查结果,在标签一级解析这些影响,并将稳健性与遵守基本编码概念区分开来。

blocks.en: 2.2 Codebook Optimization with LLMs
blocks.zh: 2.2 最佳操作手册

blocks.en:
A complementary line of research explores how LLMs themselves can be used to optimize codebook-prompts for LLM inference. Abraham et al. (2025) propose Automatic Prompt Optimization (APO), starting with a human-labeled subset and an initial task prompt. The LLM repeatedly generates semantically equivalent variations, evaluates them on the labeled data, and retains the best-performing prompts. Additionally, Zhao et al. (2025) introduce the multi-agent framework SCALE. SCALE simulates collaborative coding processes, including discussion and evolving codebooks. In our study, we apply APO and SCALE, analysing their robustness, comparability, and impact on the quality of codebooks.
While prompt optimization techniques focus on improving predictive performance, their effects on robustness, and conceptual validity remain unexplored. In this work, we systematically analyse how codebook optimization interact with LLM-based annotation pipelines and show that performance improvements can coincide with amplified failure modes.
blocks.zh:
互补的一行研究探索LLM本身如何用来优化LLM推论的编码本-瞬间. Abraham等人(2025年)提出自动即时优化(APO),从人类标记的子集和初始任务提示开始. LLM反复生成模态等效的变体,在标注的数据上对其进行评价,并保留表现最好的提示. 此外,赵等人(2025年)引入了多剂框架SCALE. SCALE模拟协作编码过程,包括讨论和不断发展的代码本. 在我们的研究中,我们应用了APO和SCALE,分析它们的强性,可比性,以及对编码本质量的影响.
虽然即时优化技术侧重于改进预测性能,但其对稳健性和概念有效性的影响仍未加以探讨。 在这项工作中,我们系统分析代码集优化如何与基于LLM的注释管道相互作用,并显示性能的改进可以与放大故障模式同步.

blocks.en: 3 Data and Evaluation Setup
blocks.zh: 3 数据和评价设置

blocks.en:
To address robustness, we evaluate across four datasets varying in domain, size, and label count (Table 1 ; codebooks in Appendix A ). We include the CCC dataset ( Halterman and Keith, 2025 ) (on protests in the United States) and Minimum Wage dataset Ruckdeschel and Wiedemann (2023) (on the impact of minimum wage policies) from prior work to ensure comparability.
In addition, we introduce and release two datasets on Value Creation across distinct sources: the Value Creation Science dataset, derived from scientific literature, and the Value Creation News , compiled from news-wire corpora.
The former is the primary dataset and the latter was developed to evaluate robustness under domain shift.
The related codebook captures concepts such as actor, demand, and resource, and was developed by a team of social scientists through an iterative annotation process, with refinements guided by inter-annotator agreement (Fleiss’ κ \kappa ). Two domain experts further provide qualitative validation for this present study.
Additional details on data sources, label sets, and annotation procedures are provided in Appendix B .

前者是主要数据集,后者是在域转移下评价稳健性的开发.

blocks.en:
Unless otherwise noted, inference experiments use Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3 ( Jiang et al., 2023 ) at temperature 0.3, an open and relatively compact model accessible to a wide range of researchers. 2 2 2 We use a temperature of 0.3 to enable the run-to-run variability observed in prior work and to stay close to the provider defaults and chat interfaces that CSS practitioners typically rely on ( Tai et al., 2024 ) . Cross-model comparisons appear in Section 4.2 . To ensure comparability with the original SCALE setup, we run all three methods with GPT-4o.
We report accuracy , micro-F1 , macro-F1 , macro-Precision , and Worst-Label-F1 to surface disparities masked by aggregate metrics. Accuracy measures the fraction of instances where every label of that instance is predicted correctly. For codebook-optimization approaches, we additionally report a human expert evaluation with Likert scale to evaluate the resulting codebook quality on Value Creation Science .

我们报告精确度,微F1,宏F1,宏精度,以及最差的Label-F1, 表面差异被总的测量值掩盖。 准确性衡量了准确预测该实例每一标签的一小部分。 关于编码手册的优化办法,我们另外报告一个带有Irikrt尺度的人类专家评价,评价由此产生的价值创造科学的编码手册质量。

blocks.en: 4 Failure Modes in Inference
blocks.zh: 4 推断失败模式

blocks.en: In the following subsections, we present the results of the inference experiments structured along their respective identified failure modes. Starting from an Unchanged codebook baseline (Table 2 ), we examine issues such as label-level disparities and overinterpretation. We further probe reliability through prompt diagnostics, evaluate context sensitivity via formatting and dataset variations, measure stochastic stability with repeated runs, test domain transfer on a new corpus, and assess model generalization across five LLMs.
blocks.zh: 在以下各小节中,我们介绍按各自确定的故障模式结构的推论实验的结果。 从未更改的编码本基线(表2)开始,我们审查诸如标签级别差异和解释过度等问题。 我们通过迅速的诊断进一步探究可靠性,通过格式化和数据集的变异评估上下文的敏感性,用重复运行来测量结构稳定性,在新实体上测试域转移,并评估五个有限责任公司模型的通用。

blocks.en: 4.1 Reliability of Label Application
blocks.zh: 4.1 标签应用程序的可靠性

blocks.en:
Standard metrics such as accuracy and micro-F1 aggregate across labels and can therefore mask severe per-category failures, a problem compounded by the highly imbalanced datasets typical of CSS. Balanced performance is essential for valid downstream interpretation. For example, in a simple frequency analysis of how often a concept appears in a corpus, systematic underperformance on certain labels directly biases results. Moreover, robust generalization to datasets with different label distributions requires models to perform reliably across all categories.
Our experiments expose this pattern (Table 2 ). In Minimum Wage , the label Youth-and-Secondary-Wage-Earners (support = 5) achieves the lowest F1 ( 28.90 28.90 ), while Social-Justice/Injustice (support = 59) reaches 72.97. More strikingly, the gap between worst-label-F1 and micro-F1 is 30 points for Minimum Wage , 26 points for Value Creation Science , and 28 points for CCC , which are differences entirely invisible in aggregate reporting.
The consistent gap between macro-F1 and micro-F1 across all experiments further confirms uneven performance.
blocks.zh:
标准衡量标准,如准确性和跨标签的微F1总和,因此可以掩盖每个类别严重故障,而CSS典型的高度不平衡数据集又加剧了这一问题。 平衡的业绩对下游的有效解释至关重要。 例如,在一个简单的频率分析中,一个概念常常出现在一个实体中,某些标签上的系统性表现不佳直接导致偏差。 此外,对具有不同标签分布的数据集的有力概括要求模型在所有类别中可靠地发挥作用。
我们的实验揭示了这种模式(表2)。 在《最低工资》中, " 青年和二等耳 " (支助=5)的标签是最低的F1(28.90 28.90),而 " 社会公正/不公正 " (支助=59)。 更引人注目的是,最差标签-F1和微型-F1之间的差距是最低工资的30分,价值创造科学的26分,以及核心承诺的28分,这些差异在合并报告中是完全看不见的。
所有实验中宏观-F1和微观-F1之间的持续差距进一步证实性能不平衡。

blocks.en:
Ruckdeschel (2025) identify overinterpretation as a recurring issue in LLM-based coding: models infer meaning beyond what is explicitly stated. Our quantitative results confirm this tendency. In two of the three datasets, macro-Precision falls below macro-F1 (Table 2 ), indicating that models assign labels more liberally than the gold standard warrants.
At the label level, precision lags behind recall in 17 of 24 labels, pointing to systematic overprediction rather than isolated errors.
For CSS workflows that rely on label frequencies or co-occurrence counts ( Baumann et al., 2025 ; Gligoric et al., 2025 ) , such overcoding inflates the apparent prevalence of concepts in a corpus and can distort substantive conclusions.
blocks.zh:
Ruckdeschel(2025)在基于LLM的编码中将过度解释确定为一个反复出现的问题:模型推断出超出明确表述的意义. 我们的量化结果证实了这一趋势。 在三个数据集中的两个数据集中,宏精度低于宏F1(表2),表明模型比金本位授权书更宽松地指定标签.
在标签层面,24个标签中有17个的精确度落后于召回,说明系统性的过度预测而非孤立的错误.
对于依赖标签频率或共发生计数的CSS工作流程(Baumann等人,2025年;Gligoric等人,2025年),这种过度编码夸大了某一实体中概念的明显普遍性,并可能扭曲实质性结论。

blocks.en:
A central assumption of codebook-based content analysis is that the model follows the provided definitions rather than defaulting to background knowledge acquired during pretraining. Ziems et al. (2024) argue that zero-shot performance is strongest when a model’s internal concept overlaps with the intended construct (e.g., stance or emotion detection), but declines on tasks requiring compliance with detailed instructions. Halterman and Keith (2025) make this issue explicit with two diagnostics: Generic Label Accuracy (replacing labels with pseudo-labels such as “Label 1”) and Swapped Label Accuracy (permuting names and definitions). Building on this work, we introduce a third diagnostic, Label-Only , in which inference uses only label names, without their definitions.
The results (Table 2 ) reveal a consistent pattern across datasets: Label-Only achieves surprisingly high scores (Table 2 ), especially for Value Creation Science , suggesting that models lean heavily on label names. In contrast, performance drops substantially under Generic Label and Swapped Label , sometimes more than in the Label-Only case, confirming reliance on label name over definitions.
blocks.zh:
基于代码库的内容分析的一个中心假设是,模型遵循提供的定义,而不是默认在预训期间获得的背景知识. Ziems等人(2024年)认为,当模型的内部概念与预期构造(如姿态或情感检测)重叠时,零射性能最强,但在需要遵守详细指示的任务上却下降. Harterman和Keith(2025年)用两种诊断方法明确了这一问题: 通用标签精确度(用“标签1”等伪标签替换标签)和Swapped标签精确度(精密名称和定义)。 在这项工作的基础上,我们引入了第三个诊断法,即Label-Only,其中推论只使用标签名称,而没有定义.
结果(表2)显示各数据集的一贯模式: 尤其对于价值创造科学, 相比之下,性能在通用标签和Swapped标签(Swapped Label)下大幅下降,有时比Label-Only案例要多,证实依赖标签名称而不是定义.

blocks.en: 4.2 Robustness
blocks.zh: 4.2 强性

blocks.en: Figure 2: Aggregated mean F 1 scores over 15 runs, illustrating the stabilizing effect of averaging multiple runs for each label.
blocks.zh: 图2:平均F1总得分超过15分,说明每个标签平均多次得分的稳定效应。

blocks.en: Prior work offers various, often conflicting guidelines for prompt design in LLM-based content analysis. We isolate three such recommendations, applying each as a single modification to the Unchanged codebook baseline (Table 2 ).
blocks.zh: 先前的工作为基于LLM的内容分析提供了各种往往相互矛盾的即时设计准则。 我们孤立了三项此类建议,每项建议都作为单一修改,适用于编码手册的基线(表2)。

blocks.en:
Ruckdeschel (2025) advocates for shorter, concise codebooks, while Halterman and Keith (2025) suggest using full codebooks for better overall performance.
In our experiments, we use labels and their definitions as simplified codebooks, removing examples, clarifications and counter-examples ( i. Simple codebook, Table 2 ).
We see that simplified codebooks degrade both micro/macro-F1 for Value Creation Science and CCC datasets, but improve overall performance on Minimum Wage marginally.
blocks.zh:
Ruckdeschel(2025年)主张更短,简洁的代码本,而Harterman和Keith(2025年)则建议使用完整的代码本来提高整体性能.
在我们的实验中,我们使用标签及其定义作为简化的代码簿,去掉实例,澄清和反实例(即简单的代码簿,表2.
我们看到,简化的代码簿降低了价值创造科学的微观/宏观-F1和核心承诺数据集,但略微提高了最低工资的总体绩效。

blocks.en:
Halterman and Keith (2025) recommend explicit structural markers, e.g. prefixing each field with “definition:” or “example:”.
In our experiments, when using their structured codebook style ( ii. Structured , Table 2 ), CCC shows substantial gains across nearly all metrics, while Minimum Wage and Value Creation Science exhibit significant decreases in all metrics.
We attribute this outcome to the average length of the texts in CCC , which is by far the longest of the three.
Information signaled by markers ("definition") may help the model retrieve relevant information from the full context window.
blocks.zh:
Harterman和Keith(2025年)建议采用明确的结构标记,例如每个字段前缀“定义:”或“实例:”。
在我们的实验中,当使用其结构化的代码本风格(ii. 在结构上(表2),核心承诺显示,几乎所有的衡量标准都取得了显著进展,而最低工资和价值创造科学则显示,所有衡量标准都显著下降。
我们将此结果归因于《核心承诺书》中文本的平均长度,这是迄今为止三个文本中最长的文本。
由标记("定义")信号的信息可能有助于模型从整个上下文窗口获取相关信息.

blocks.en:
Following Dunivin (2025) ’s clause-order finding, we place majority labels first ( iii. Majority Order ).
As shown in Table 2 , this ordering yields only minor changes for Minimum Wage and Value Creation Science , but substantially degrades performance on CCC . Strikingly, CCC achieves its best micro/macro-F1 when the majority label order is inverted ( iii. Inverted Order ), though this harms performance on the other two datasets.
blocks.zh:
根据Dunivin(2025年)的条款顺序,
如表2所示,这一命令只导致最低工资和价值创造科学的微小变化,但极大地降低了核心承诺的绩效。 令人惊奇的是,当多数标签顺序倒置(iii. Inverted Order )时,CCC会达到其最佳的微/宏-F1,尽管这有损于其他两个数据集的性能.

blocks.en: These contradictory outcomes across three independent design dimensions may help explain why studies, especially those with limited dataset diversity, sometimes arrive at opposing best-practice recommendations.
blocks.zh: 这些涉及三个独立设计层面的相互矛盾的结果可能有助于解释为什么研究,特别是那些数据集多样性有限的研究有时得出相反的最佳做法建议。

blocks.en:
As Ramanathan et al. (2025) note, LLM (GPT-4) performance can vary across repeated runs.
We observe the same effect with open-weight models when setting temperature above zero and not fixing a random seed. 3 3 3 Note that temperature 0 reduces but does not fully eliminate non-determinism in hosted settings ( Atıl et al., 2025 ) , so repeated runs remain informative even under greedy decoding. Figure 2 shows the aggregated mean F1 scores over 15 such runs.
The degree of instability is dataset- and label-dependent (Figure 2 ). For CCC , scores remain highly stable. Value Creation Science shows moderate run-to-run differences that are reduced by averaging three runs, while Minimum Wage exhibits stronger variation, particularly for the low-support label TURNOVER .
The pattern is consistent with the label-level disparities documented in Section 4.1 : categories with small support are most vulnerable to both systematic underperformance and stochastic noise.
Our observed variance is modest compared to the greater instability reported by Ramanathan et al. (2025) , likely because open-weight models allow transparent control over sampling parameters. Closed-source APIs, by contrast, may introduce opaque configuration changes between provider updates, compounding run-to-run variability with silent shifts in model behaviour.
blocks.zh:
正如Ramanathan等人(2025年)所指出,LLM(GPT-4)的性能可以因重复运行而异.
在设定温度高于零时,我们用开放量模型观察到同样的效果,而不是修补随机的种子。 3 3 注意温度0会降低但不会完全消除主机环境下的非定型性(Atıl等人,2025年),所以反复运行即使在贪婪的解码下仍然信息丰富. 图2显示15次此类运行的总平均F1分。
不稳定的程度取决于数据集和标签(图2)。 对于CCC来说,得分保持高度稳定. " 价值创造科学 " 显示,中等程度的从运行到运行的差异会减少平均3次,而最低工资则显示出更大的差异,特别是在低支持标签TURNOVER方面。
这种模式与第4.1节中记录的标签级别差异是一致的:小支持的类别最容易受到系统性性能不佳和结构性噪音的影响。
与Ramanathan等人(2025年)报告的更大的不稳定性相比,我们观察到的差异不大,这可能是因为开放式模型允许对取样参数进行透明的控制。 相比之下,闭源API可能会在提供者更新之间引入不透明的配置变化,将运行到运行的变异性与模型行为的无声变化相复合.

blocks.en:
We compare GPT-4o-mini, DeepSeek-V3 ( DeepSeek-AI et al., 2025 ) , Gemma-2-27B-it ( Team et al., 2024 ) , Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, and Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3 ( Jiang et al., 2023 ) using the Unchanged codebook on all three datasets (Figure 3 ).
No model dominates consistently.
For the Value Creation Science dataset, performance levels are relatively close: Gemma achieves the highest precision, while DeepSeek leads in micro/macro-F1 . Llama, in contrast, performs weakest overall. On the CCC dataset, Gemma’s F1 scores drop drastically, up to 25 percentage points below the other models, whereas the compact Mistral performs comparably to the much larger DeepSeek and GPT models. The pattern reverses for the Minimum Wage dataset, where Gemma consistently outperforms all others, while Mistral and Llama lag behind.
The absence of a stable model ranking across datasets poses a systemic threat for CSS. If conclusions depend heavily on which model (or version) is chosen, downstream analyses risk being contingent on arbitrary or even opaque implementation details. Closed-source models amplify this problem, as providers update them without notice, leading to silent shifts in performance and prompt sensitivity. What appears to be a stable, replicable pipeline today may yield different results, undermining the credibility of published findings, and may as a consequence even impact policy making.
blocks.zh:
我们比较了GPT-4o-mini,DeepSeek-V3(DeepSeek-AI等人,2025年),Gemma-227B-it(Team等人,2024年),Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct,以及Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3(Jiang等人,2023年)使用所有三个数据集的未更改代码表(图3).
没有任何模式持续占据主导地位。
对于价值创造科学数据集来说,性能水平相对接近: Gemma实现最高精度,而DeepSeek则在微/macro-F1中领先. 相比之下,Llama的总体表现最差。 在CC数据集上,Gemma的F1分数大幅下降,比其他模型低25个百分点,而紧凑的Mistral则与更大的DeepSeek和GPT模型相比。 最低工资数据集的模式倒置,Gemma一直比所有其他数据集都好,而Mistral和Llama则落后。
数据集之间缺乏稳定的模型排名,对中央支助系统构成系统性威胁。 如果结论在很大程度上取决于选择哪种模式(或版本),则下游分析有可能取决于任意甚至不透明的实施细节。 封闭源码模型加剧了这一问题,因为供应商在不事先通知的情况下更新这些模型,导致性能的无声变化和迅速的敏感性。 今天看来稳定、可复制的管道可能会产生不同的结果,损害已公布调查结果的可信度,并因此影响决策。

blocks.en:
A critical assumption in codebook-based content analysis is that coding frameworks remain valid across new data sources within the same theoretical domain.
We test this assumption by applying the Value Creation Science codebook, developed on academic publications, to news articles covering the same business and economics topics. Both corpora share the underlying constructs but differ in register: style, vocabulary, and communicative conventions change.
The results expose a paradox (Table 3 ). On one side, the per-label performance improves substantially in the news domain: micro-F1 rises from 44.89 to 62.22 and macro-F1 from 39.57 to 59.55, likely because news articles use simpler language and more direct formulations (qualitative examples in Appendix C ).
On the other side, this confidence does not extend to a holistic understanding of the coding task: the model fails to predict the full correct label set for any single instance, resulting in an overall accuracy of 0.0.
Such domain sensitivity poses significant risks for comparative analyses and theory testing in CSS. A codebook that performs well on one text type may yield systematically different results on another, even when both sources address the same substantive questions. These inconsistencies can lead to spurious empirical patterns or failed replications.
blocks.zh:
基于代码库的内容分析中的一个重要假设是,编码框架在同一个理论领域的新数据来源中仍然有效。
我们通过将学术出版物上开发的《价值创造科学法典》应用于报道同一商业和经济主题的新闻文章来检验这一假设。 公司和公司都认同基本结构,但在登记方面却有所不同:风格、词汇和交流惯例都发生了变化。
结果暴露出一个悖论(表3). 一方面,每个标签的性能大大改善了新闻领域:微F1从44.89升至62.22,宏观F1从39.57升至59.55,可能是因为新闻文章使用更简单的语言和更直接的配方(附录C中的定性例子).
另一方面,这种信心并没有延伸到对编码任务的整体理解:模型未能预测任何单一实例设置的完全正确的标签,导致总体准确度达到0.0.
这种域敏感度对CSS的比较分析和理论测试构成重大风险. 在一种文本类型上表现良好的编码本可能会对另一种文本产生系统不同的结果,即使这两种来源都涉及同样的实质性问题。 这些不一致可能导致虚假的经验模式或失败的复制.

blocks.en: 5 Failure Modes in Optimization
blocks.zh: 5 优化失败模式

blocks.en:
Failure modes in LLM-based coding do not arise only during inference, additional risks emerge when LLMs are used to optimize codebooks that are later applied during inference.
To study these effects, we first implement targeted minimal optimizations, introducing small structured changes to the original codebook to test their impact across datasets (see Table 4 ). These perturbations are generated zero-shot in a single LLM rollout.
blocks.zh:
基于LLM的编码中的失败模式不仅仅在推论期间出现,当LLMS被用于优化后来在推论期间应用的代码本时会出现额外的风险.
为了研究这些效果,我们首先实施目标最小的优化,对原始编码手册进行小的结构性修改,以测试其跨数据集的影响(见表4)。 这些扰动在一次LLM的推出中产生零镜头.

blocks.en:
Second, we evaluate real-world approaches, in which the complete codebook is optimized.
Specifically, we apply (i) a zero-shot full-codebook improvement ( FULL ), prompting an LLM to refine the entire codebook; (ii) APO by Abraham et al. (2025) ; and (iii) the multi-agent framework SCALE ( Zhao et al., 2025 ) , both iterative prompt refinement methods.
Using these setups, we analyse potential risks such as concept drift, bias amplification, and the practical feasibility of LLM-based codebook optimization.
blocks.zh:
第二,我们评价现实世界的方法,其中优化了完整的密码本。
具体而言,我们采用(一) 零镜头全码本改进(FULL),促使LLM完善整个码本;(二) 亚伯拉罕等人的APO(2025年);(三) 多剂框架SCALE(赵等人,2025年),两者都是迭代的即时完善方法。
利用这些设置,我们分析潜在的风险,如概念漂移,偏移放大,以及基于LLM的代码本优化的实际可行性.

blocks.en: 5.1 Amplified Bias and Sensitivity
blocks.zh: 5.1 放大比亚斯和敏感度

blocks.en:
The label-level disparities observed during inference (Section 4.1 ) are amplified when LLMs are used to optimize codebooks. Small modifications to definitions or examples can disproportionately shift performance across labels (see Table 4 ).
When evaluation relies solely on aggregate metrics, such as micro-F1 , there is a danger of endorsing adaptations that improve majority classes while harming minority ones.
A concrete case illustrates the danger: adding positive and negative examples improves micro/macro-F1 , accuracy , and macro-Precision on both CCC and Value Creation Science , yet simultaneously drives worst-label-F1 down to 5.67 and 11.32 respectively. Judged by aggregate metrics alone, these optimizations would be endorsed as beneficial. In practice, they systematically suppress minority categories, precisely the labels most vulnerable to begin with. The problem is compounded by automatic methods such as APO, which optimize for micro-F1 by design and therefore have no mechanism to prevent minority-label degradation.
blocks.zh:
在推断(第4.1节)中观察到的标签级差异,在使用LLMs优化代码簿时被放大. 对定义或示例的微小修改可以不成比例地改变不同标签的性能(见表4)。
当评价完全依靠总的衡量标准,如微观-F1时,就存在着一种危险,即赞同改进多数阶层同时又损害少数群体阶层的适应措施。
一个具体案例说明了这种危险:增加积极和消极的例子可以改善CCC和价值创造科学的微观/宏观-F1、准确性和宏观精度,但同时又将最差的标签-F1分别降低到5.67和11.32。 仅从总的衡量尺度来看,这些优化将被认为是有益的。 在实践中,它们有系统地压制少数群体类别,正是最容易首先出现的标签。 自动方法,如APO,使问题更加复杂,这种方法通过设计对微F1进行优化,因此没有防止少数民族标签退化的机制.

blocks.zh: 表5:通过三种办法优化标签版本。

blocks.en: The dataset sensitivity documented for inference (Section 4.2 ) intensifies when LLMs are used to optimize codebooks, since each refinement step compounds the interaction between prompt wording and data characteristics. The absence of universal optimization rules motivates automated methods such as APO and SCALE, yet these introduce systematic risks of their own.
blocks.zh: 为推断而记录的数据集敏感性(第4.2节)在使用LLMS优化代码簿时会增强,因为每个完善步骤都使快速措辞与数据特征之间的相互作用复杂化. 缺乏普遍优化规则,激发了APO和SCALE等自动化方法,然而这些方法也带来了其自身的系统性风险.

blocks.en:
Our experiments show that even minimal adjustments, like adding examples, inserting clarifications, or reformulating definitions produce inconsistent effects across datasets (Table 4 ). What improves performance in one setting often degrades it in another, casting doubt on the existence of generalizable strategies for LLM-based refinements. This underscores the need for dataset-specific optimization methods that adapt prompts automatically rather than relying on fixed heuristics.
Among real-world optimization methods, the simple FULL approach proves most stable, with macro-F1 decreasing by at most 5 points across datasets (Table 4 ).
APO is more volatile: it performs well on CCC , but for Value Creation Science it removed one label entirely, leading to weaker results.
SCALE also exhibits high variability, improving CCC performance but reducing most metrics for the other two datasets. For Value Creation Science , repeated SCALE runs produced drastically different and inconsistent outcomes ranging from leaving all labels unchanged to completely rewriting the codebook, resulting in labels that bore little resemblance to the originals.
This run-level instability means that even the choice of which optimization run to deploy becomes a consequential, yet essentially arbitrary, decision.
blocks.zh:
我们的实验表明,即使是微小的调整,如添加实例、插入澄清或重新定义,也会产生不同数据集不一致的效果(表4)。 在一个环境中改进性能的事物往往在另一个环境中降低性能,使人怀疑是否存在基于LLM的通用改进策略。 这突出表明,需要采用针对数据集的优化方法,自动调整提示,而不是依赖固定heuristics。

这种运行的不稳定性意味着,即使选择最优化部署,也成为一项必然的决定,但基本上是任意的决定。

blocks.en: 5.2 Conceptual Validity of Optimized Codebooks
blocks.zh: 5.2 最佳编码手册的概念有效性

blocks.en:
Optimization alters label definitions and occasionally label names, raising the question of whether the resulting codebooks still capture the theoretical constructs encoded in the original design.
To evaluate this, two domain experts assessed each label description in the Value Creation Science dataset using a 1–4 Likert scale ( Lynn, 1986 ) , a method commonly used to evaluate natural language generation outputs ( Amidei et al., 2019 ) . Due to low rating variance, inter-annotator agreement measured by Cohen’s κ \kappa is relatively low ( κ = 0.34 \kappa=0.34 ), although the observed agreement between annotators is high: 51.6% exact agreement and 87.3% of ratings differing by at most one scale point. 4 4 4 Cohen’s κ \kappa adjusts observed agreement by the agreement expected by chance. When rating variance is low (i.e., both annotators tend to use the same rating categories very frequently), the expected chance agreement becomes high. This reduces the resulting κ \kappa value even if the annotators largely agree in practice. In our case, both annotators consistently assigned high scores, and one rater frequently used the maximum score (4), which increases expected chance agreement and lowers κ \kappa . Three dimensions were evaluated: relevance , clarity , distinctiveness (see Appendix G ).
blocks.zh:
优化会改变标签定义,偶尔也会给名称贴上标签,从而引发了由此产生的编码本是否仍然能捕捉到原设计中编码的理论构造的问题.
为了评价这一点,两位域专家在价值创造科学数据集中评估了每个标签描述,使用了1–4的Ikrt比例尺(Lynn,1986年),这一方法通常用于评价自然语言生成输出(Amidei等人,2019年). 由于评级差异小,以Cohen obs= 0.34\kappa= 0.34衡量的注释者之间的协议相对较低(obs= 0.34\kappa= 0.34),尽管注意到的注释者之间的协议是很高的:51.6%的准确协议和87.3%的评级在最多一个比分点上有所不同. 4 4 4 Cohen's off \kappa 调整所观察到的协议, 当评级差异低(即两个注释者往往经常使用相同的评级类别)时,预期的机会协议就会变得很高。 这样即使注释者在实际操作中基本一致,也会减少所产生的 ox\kappa 值。 在我们的情况中,两个注目者都一贯给定高分,一个评分者经常使用最高分数(4),这增加了预期的机会协议,降低了 \ kappa 。 评价了三个方面:相关性、清晰度、独特性(见附录G)。

blocks.en: For relevance, the expert evaluated whether each label still reflected the intended concept of the original codebook. The highest mean score was achieved by SCALE (3.56), followed by FULL (3.44) and APO (3.19) (Figure 5 ). The APO approach received consistently high ratings, except for the label FRAMEWORK , which was removed during optimization. Despite this, overall performance in Table 4 remains strong given that one label could not be detected.
blocks.zh: 关于相关性,专家评价了每个标签是否仍然反映了原编码本的预期概念。 最高平均分由SCALE(3.56)实现,其次是FULL(3.44)和APO(3.19)(图5). APO方法一直获得很高的评分,但标签框架除外,在优化过程中被删除。 尽管如此,由于无法检测到一个标签,表4的总体性能依然强劲。

blocks.en:
Since codebooks are intended for downstream analysis, it is essential that optimized label descriptions remain interpretable and clear to social scientists.
Both SCALE outperforms FULL and APO with mean clarity scores of 3.44 compared to 3.25 and 3.06. This gap may stem from the richer definitions and examples that help differentiate labels (see Table 5 ).
blocks.zh:
由于代码册是用于下游分析的,因此,对于社会科学家来说,优化标签描述必须保持可解释性和清晰性。
SCALE的成绩均超过FLL和APO,平均清晰分为3.44分,相比之下3.25分和3.06分. 这一差距可能源于有助于区分标签的更丰富的定义和实例(见表5)。

blocks.en:
For codebooks to be analytically useful, labels must remain clearly distinct from one another.
Again, FULL and SCALE yield higher mean Likert scores than APO.

编码簿若要在分析上有用,标签必须明确区分。
同样,FLL和SCALE的得分平均比APO高.

blocks.en: For clarity and relevance , SCALE produces definitions experts judge superior to FULL (detailed scores in Appendix F . Yet FULL often achieves higher F1 scores (Table 4 ), revealing a disconnect: predictive gains can arise from simplified definitions that better align with model behavior while reducing conceptual interpretability. This tension highlights that quantitative metrics alone are insufficient for CSS applications where codebooks encode theoretical constructs.
blocks.zh: 为了明确和具有相关性,SCALE编制的定义专家判断优于FLL(附录F详细分数)。 然而,FLUL常常能达到更高的F1分数(表4),揭示出一个脱节:可以由简化的定义产生预测收益,这些定义可以更好地与模型行为保持一致,同时降低概念解释性. 这种张力突出地表明,光是量化度量标准不足以用于编码本编码理论构造的CSS应用.

blocks.en: 5.3 Efficiency and Accessibility
blocks.zh: 5.3 效率和无障碍

blocks.en:
Beyond performance, optimization approaches must also be feasible for researchers in practice. We therefore compare the efficiency of different methods by counting the number of API calls required for each approach (see Table 6 ). This provides an approximate measure of computational cost.
FULL requires a single call per dataset. SCALE uses 688–1,044 calls depending on the dataset. APO requires 113,200 calls uniformly, over two orders of magnitude more than SCALE and five orders more than FULL, yet does not consistently outperform either alternative (Table 4 ). The cost-benefit profile of iterative optimization is thus far from guaranteed. Beyond cost, accessibility also matters: minimal prompt adjustments are within reach of any social scientist, whereas APO and SCALE demand non-trivial engineering skills.
blocks.zh:
除了业绩外,优化方法对于研究人员来说也必须在实践中可行。 因此,我们通过计算每种方法所需的API呼叫次数来比较不同方法的效率(见表6)。 这提供了计算费用的大致尺度。
FULL需要每个数据集单调. SCALE根据数据集使用688–1,044呼叫. APO需要113,200个统一电话,比SCALE多两个数量级,5个数量级比FLL多,但并非始终比这两种选择都好(表4)。 因此,迭代优化的成本效益还远未得到保证。 除了成本以外,无障碍环境也很重要:任何社会科学家都能够迅速作出最小的调整,而APO和SCALE则需要非三角工程技能。

blocks.en: 6 Minimal Validation Protocol
blocks.zh: 6 最低审定协议

blocks.en: To mitigate failure modes from Sections 4 and 5 , we recommend the following minimal, low-cost validation protocol, intended as a practical screening procedure rather than a statistically exhaustive evaluation:
blocks.zh: 为了减轻第4节和第5节的故障模式,我们建议采用以下最低成本、低成本的验证协议,作为实际筛选程序,而不是统计上详尽无遗的评估:

blocks.en: Minimal Validation Protocol Tail Risk: Report macro-F1 , worst-label-F1 , per label scores and label supports alongside micro-F1/accuracy; include macro-Precision to detect overcoding. Meaning Adherence: Test Label-Only , Generic Label , and Swapped Label to detect reliance on label-name semantics. Stability: Repeat inference ≥ 3 \geq 3 as a practical minimum for detecting substantial instability; report the number of runs and the resulting variability, and use more runs when variance is high or the API is stochastic/opaque. Sensitivity: Apply semantics-preserving formatting or label-order perturbations to reveal prompt-specific effects. Transfer: If possible, evaluate on an additional dataset from the same domain to detect shifts under domain or style changes. Optimization Safeguards: When refining codebooks, include worst-label-F1 to protect minority labels, verify constructs with experts, and report computational cost.
blocks.zh: 最小验证协议尾端风险:报告宏-F1,最差标签-F1,每个标签分数和标签支持与微F1/准确性并列;包括宏精度检测过码. 意指遵守:测试标签单词、通用标签和Swapped标签以检测对标签名称语义的依赖。 稳定性:重复推论 3\ geq 3 作为探测重大不稳定性的实际最低限度; 报告运行次数和由此产生的变异性, 当差异大或 API 时使用更多的运行. 灵敏度:应用语义-保留格式或标签顺序扰动来揭示即时特效. 传输 : 如果可能的话,从同一个域对额外的数据集进行评价,以检测域或样式变化下的移位. 优化保障措施: 在完善代码簿时,包括最差标签-F1以保护少数标签,与专家核实构造,并报告计算成本.

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en:
LLMs enable large-scale content analysis in CSS but remain fragile and context-dependent. Our experiments demonstrate that high aggregate scores routinely coexist with severe label-level disparities, reliance on label-name semantics over codebook definitions, instability across runs, sensitivity to superficial formatting choices, and fragile domain transfer. When LLMs are additionally used to optimize codebooks, these problems do not diminish, they compound: optimization amplifies minority-label bias, produces dataset-contingent effects, and can silently alter the theoretical constructs a codebook is designed to measure.
A recurring theme across all failure modes is that standard metrics are insufficient to detect them. To address this, we proposed a minimal validation protocol (Section 6 ) that operationalizes our findings into concrete checks, intended to be lightweight enough for routine adoption in CSS research.
blocks.zh:
LLMs 可以在 CSS 中进行大规模内容分析,但依然脆弱且取决于具体情况. 我们的实验表明,高总分通常与严重的标签级别差异并存,依赖标签名称语义而不是代码簿定义,跨运行不稳定,对表面格式化选择的敏感性,以及脆弱的域转移。 当LLMS被额外用于优化编码本时,这些问题不会减少,它们会复合:优化放大少数-标签偏差,产生数据集-集合效应,可以默默地改变一个设计用来测量的编码本的理论构造.
在所有故障模式中反复出现的一个主题是标准衡量标准不足以检测到它们。 为了解决这个问题,我们提出了一个最低限度的验证协议(第6节),将我们的调查结果化为具体的检查,目的是使重量足够轻,供CSS研究例行采用。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: Our analysis is limited to a small set of datasets, codebooks, and model configurations. While these reflect common CSS research settings, results may not generalize across domains, languages, or annotation frameworks. Nonetheless, our evaluation framework is applicable to any dataset, codebook, or LLM, and we hope future work will extend it to larger, multilingual, and domain-specific contexts. Finally, the human evaluation of optimized codebooks relies on only two experts, which may limit intersubjective validity.
blocks.zh: 我们的分析仅限于一小组数据集,代码簿和模型配置. 虽然这些都反映了共同的CSS研究环境,但成果可能无法在各个领域、语言或注释框架之间通用。 然而,我们的评价框架适用于任何数据集、编码本或LLM,我们希望今后的工作将扩大到更大、多语种和具体领域的情况。 最后,人类对优化代码手册的评价仅依靠两位专家,这可能会限制主体间的有效性.

blocks.en: Ethical Considerations
blocks.zh: 道德考虑

blocks.en:
This work studies the reliability of LLM-based text annotation and highlights potential risks when such annotations are used in downstream social science analyses. By identifying failure modes in inference and codebook optimization, our goal is to promote more transparent and responsible use of LLMs as measurement tools in research workflows.
All datasets used in this study are either publicly available or released by the authors with appropriate documentation. We do not introduce new personal or sensitive data, and our experiments focus on methodological evaluation rather than producing judgments about individuals or groups.
LLMs were used to assist with grammar, spelling, and refinement of the manuscript text. All technical content, analyses, and conclusions were developed and verified by the authors.
blocks.zh:
这项工作研究了基于LLM的文本注释的可靠性,并强调了在下游社会科学分析中使用这种注释的潜在风险。 通过确定失败模式推论和代码手册优化,我们的目标是促进在研究工作流程中更加透明和负责任地使用LLMs作为衡量工具。
本研究报告中使用的所有数据集要么公开提供,要么由作者以适当的文件予以公布。 我们没有提出新的个人或敏感数据,我们的实验侧重于方法评价,而不是对个人或团体作出判断。
LLMs被用于协助文法,拼写,以及手稿文本的完善. 所有技术内容、分析和结论都由作者编写和核实。

It is possible,

aspects. Below, the aspect categories are further explained. Each category has a label name and details defining or illustrating them. blocks.en: This appendix describes the construction of the datasets Value Creation Science and Value Creation News . The datasets were developed as part of the Wertschöpfungsradar (Value Creation Radar, WSR) research project.
blocks.zh: 本附录描述数据集"价值创造科学与价值创造新闻"的构建. 数据集是作为Wertschöpfungsradar(Value Creation Radar,WSR)研究项目的一部分开发的.

blocks.en: B.1 Original Dataset
blocks.zh: B.1 原始数据集

blocks.en: B.1.1 Annotation Scheme
blocks.zh: B.1.1 注释计划

blocks.en: The annotation scheme is grounded in an abstract model of value creation systems, which distinguishes eight interdependent categories that characterise the essential elements of value creation processes. Each category is defined relationally—that is, through its connections to other elements in the model. The categories and their definitions are as follows:
blocks.zh: 注释计划基于一个抽象的价值创造系统模型,它区分了八个相互依存的类别,这些类别是价值创造过程的基本要素。 每个类别都有相对的定义——即通过其与模型中其他要素的联系。 类别及其定义如下:

blocks.en: • Actor ( 0 ): an individual or a collective that contributes a resource at its disposal to a process of creating an artefact. • Resource ( 1 ): a capability of an actor that is used in the process of creating an artefact. • Process ( 2 ): an activity for the creation of an artefact to which actors contribute their resources. • Pattern ( 3 ): an organising principle through which a process integrates the resources to create an artefact. • Artefact ( 4 ): a good that is created by integrating resources according to a pattern and that serves a demand. • Demand ( 5 ): an articulated or anticipated need that an artefact serves. • Revenue ( 6 ): a return an actor receives for contributing to the process of creating an artefact. • Framework ( 7 ): a context factor that influences how value creation takes place.
blocks.zh: • 行为人(0):向造物工艺贡献其可支配资源的个人或集体。 • 资源(1):一个行动者的能力,用于创造动脉。 • 进程(2):一项创造艺术的活动,行动者为此提供资源。 • 模式(3):一种组织原则,即一个过程将资源整合在一起,以创造一种人工制品。 • Artefact(4):一种根据一种模式整合资源并满足需求而创造的优点。 • 需求(5):一种动脉动能服务于的明确或预期需求。 • 收入(6):一名行动者因协助制作人工制品而获得回报。 • 框架(7):影响如何创造价值的背景因素。

blocks.en: Actor ( 0 ): an individual or a collective that contributes a resource at its disposal to a process of creating an artefact.
blocks.zh: 演员(0):为创作动脉动画而贡献其可支配资源的个人或集体.

blocks.en: Resource ( 1 ): a capability of an actor that is used in the process of creating an artefact.

blocks.en: Artefact ( 4 ): a good that is created by integrating resources according to a pattern and that serves a demand.
blocks.zh: 艺术(4):一种根据一种模式整合资源并满足需求而创造的好处。

blocks.en: Demand ( 5 ): an articulated or anticipated need that an artefact serves.

blocks.en: Annotators were instructed to label noun phrases in English-language abstracts of scientific articles about value creation. Labels capture both positive and negative instances of each category (e.g., financial losses are labelled Revenue ; material costs are labelled Resource ).
blocks.zh: 已指示注释者在关于价值创造的科学文章的英文摘要中标注名词短语。 标签记录了每一类别的正反两种情况(例如,财务损失被贴上收入标签;材料成本被贴上资源标签)。

blocks.en: B.1.2 Annotation Process
blocks.zh: B.1.2 注释过程

blocks.en: The annotation procedure was developed iteratively across two phases: a pilot study and a main annotation campaign.
blocks.zh: 说明程序分两个阶段迭代制定:试点研究和主要说明活动。

blocks.en: An internal pilot was conducted in June–July 2023, in which 8 annotators labelled 20 abstracts in parallel using the Doccano annotation tool. 5 5 5 https://github.com/doccano/doccano The pilot yielded a Fleiss’ κ \kappa of 0.31, indicating fair for multi-label span annotation, but insufficient agreement. A qualitative analysis of 75 annotator comments and a co-occurrence analysis of category overlaps revealed three main sources of disagreement: (i) ambiguous category boundaries, particularly between Pattern and Process , Revenue and Demand , and Actor and Framework ; (ii) missing formal coding rules regarding grammatical forms, compound phrases, and abbreviations; and (iii) insufficient attention to the value-creation context when annotating.
blocks.zh: 2023年6月至7月进行了内部试点,8名注释员使用Doccano注释工具将20份摘要标为平行的。 飞行员得出了Fleiss的0.31 o kappa , 表示在多标签间距说明上公平, 对75份注释的定性分析和对类别重叠的共发性分析揭示了三个主要分歧来源:(一) 类别界限模糊不清,特别是模式和进程、收入和需求、以及角色和框架之间的界限;(二) 缺少关于语法形式、复合短语和缩略语的正式编码规则;(三) 在注释时未充分注意价值创造背景。

blocks.en: Based on the pilot findings, the annotation guidelines were substantially revised. Key improvements included: sharpened category definitions supplemented with illustrative positive and negative examples drawn from the pilot data; the introduction of a step-by-step annotation procedure recommending that annotators first identify Actor , Process , and Artefact before turning to the remaining categories; explicit coding rules restricting annotations to complete noun phrases, prohibiting the splitting of compound expressions, and requiring annotators to consider the relationships between labelled entities as specified by the value creation model. A one-page reference sheet summarising the definitions, explanatory notes, and examples was provided as a quick-reference document.
blocks.zh: 根据试点结果,对说明准则进行了实质性修订。 主要改进包括:更清晰的类别定义,加上从试点数据中得出的说明性正面和负面实例;采用逐步说明程序,建议在转向其余类别之前先由注释者确定演员、过程和Artefact;明确编码规则,限制说明完成名词短语,禁止将复合表达方式分割开来,并要求注释者考虑价值创建模型所指定的标签实体之间的关系。 作为一份快速参考文件,提供了一页的参考页,概括了定义、解释性说明和实例。

blocks.en: Before the main campaign, annotators participated in a training session consisting of a presentation of the revised guidelines followed by a joint practice labelling exercise. An interactive training quiz was also distributed, which walked annotators through a sample text and tested their understanding of noun phrase boundaries, context-dependent category assignment, and the distinction between entities and concepts.
blocks.zh: 在主要运动之前,注释员参加了一个培训班,包括介绍经修订的准则,然后是联合做法标签。 还分发了一个交互式培训测验,通过一个样本文本使注释者走过,并测试他们对名词短语界限、上下文依赖的类别分配以及实体和概念之间的区别的理解。

blocks.en:
The main campaign began in September 2023. Annotators labelled abstracts using Doccano with the eight predefined categories. The final dataset comprises 921 annotated abstracts.
The collected annotated spans were proofed by a domain expert in order to improve label quality and remove any ambiguous data points.All involved social scientists consented to the use and release of this dataset.
blocks.zh:
2023年9月开始主战. 注释者使用 Doccano 标注了八个预定义的类别。 最后数据集包括921份附加说明的摘要。
所收集的附加说明的跨度由域专家验证,以提高标签质量并删除任何模棱两可的数据点。 所有涉及的社会科学家都同意使用和发布这一数据集。

blocks.en: B.2 Value Creation Science
blocks.zh: B.2 创造价值科学

blocks.en:
From these 921 annotated abstracts, we selected the sentences which contained annotated noun-phrases and transformed the data into a multi-label dataset.
That is, the whole sentence gets the labels of the identified spans that are contained in it.
After that, we selected only sentences with at least one label and which carried enough context for the labels they carried.
This helps to minimize context loss in the dataset transformation.
blocks.zh:
我们从这些921注解摘要中选择了含有注解名词的句子,并将数据转换成多标签数据集.
也就是说,整个句子都得到了其中包含的识别跨度的标签.
之后,我们只选择了至少一个标签的句子,这些句子上下文足以表示所携带的标签.
这有助于最大限度地减少数据集转换中上下文的损失.

blocks.en:
We additionally evaluate a fine-tuned RoBERTa Liu et al. (2019) baseline to contextualize the observed failure modes against a conventional supervised encoder model.
We fine-tune roberta-large 6 6 6 https://huggingface.co/FacebookAI/roberta-large as a multi-label, or multi-class for CCC, sequence classification model using the training split of each dataset and select the best checkpoint on the validation split. Inputs are truncated to a maximum length of 512 tokens. We train for 3 epochs with a learning rate of 2 × 10 − 5 2\times 10^{-5} , batch size 8.

blocks.en: Table 7 reports the performance of the RoBERTa baseline across the three datasets. The results show that RoBERTa exhibits a pattern similar to the one observed for LLMs: relatively high aggregate scores, especially Micro-F1, can coexist with substantially lower Macro-F1 and a Worst-Label-F1 of 0.0. What shows that even a supervised encoder baseline can achieve moderate Micro-F1 while entirely failing on minority or difficult labels. However, the underlying causes of these failures differ. In LLM-based coding pipelines, failures may arise from prompt sensitivity, run instability, domain sensitivity, or semantic drift in label interpretation. In contrast, RoBERTa’s collapse on individual labels is more likely driven by label imbalance and sparse supervision, which are common in content analysis datasets.
blocks.zh: 表7报告三个数据集的罗贝塔基线执行情况。 结果显示,RoBERTa显示出类似于LLMS观察到的模式:相对较高的总分,特别是Micro-F1,可以与大幅降低的Macro-F1和0.0的Worst-Label-F1共存. 何以表明,即使是有监督的编码器基线也能实现中度微F1,同时在少数或困难的标签上完全失败. 然而,这些失败的根本原因各不相同。 在基于LLM的编码管道中,故障可能源于快速敏感,运行不稳定,域敏感,或标签解释中的语义漂移. 反之,RoBERTa个人标签的崩溃更可能是由标签失衡和零星的监管驱动,这在内容分析数据集中很常见.
